description: Takes a registration plate and an optional letters flag (A=1..Z=26) and returns the plate total, a single number 1 to 9, with every addition step. Example input: {"plate":"MH12AB3456","letters":false}

letters.description: Also count letters as A=1 to Z=26; default false counts digits only

plate.description: Vehicle registration plate, letters and digits only, e.g. MH12AB3456

name: plateTotal
